criteria_results.notes: Live primary-session creation returned 400 with the lock reason; focused delegation and AgentRunner tests proved no engine call occurs for a locked subagent/background target.

process_issues.description: The fresh worktree had no vendored-fork node_modules, and the installed Bun 1.3.14 wanted to refresh a git dependency in the Bun 1.3.13 lock.
process_issues.detected_by: Exact sandbox build failed with `preload not found @opentui/solid/preload`; `bun install --frozen-lockfile` then reported lockfile changes. `bun install --no-save` populated ignored dependencies and the exact build passed without retained source changes.

process_issues.description: The sandbox script reached healthy but its detached API process was reaped when the launching PTY exited in this tool environment.
process_issues.detected_by: Both 4797/4798 listeners disappeared immediately after `Sandbox ready`; the clean log had no exception or shutdown event. Running the same built API in a foreground session stayed healthy and completed the smoke.

process_issues.description: Two full-suite attempts failed in unrelated HTTP tests after 359 files and 3185 tests had passed: an empty JSON body in issue_895_agent_approvals.test.ts and, later, a five-second opc_mcp_oauth_routes.test.ts timeout.
process_issues.detected_by: The exact isolated tests passed 5/5 and 3/3 without code or assertion changes. Clean restarted `ai-workflow checks --level pr` runs passed after each occurrence.

process_issues.description: An early live wrapper changed directories before its relative cleanup trap ran, so the tests passed but the outer wrapper exited 127.
process_issues.detected_by: The final wrapper used an absolute sandbox-script path; the live test passed 2/2, printed `Sandbox removed`, and released ports 4797/4798.

suggested_follow_up: Teach the sandbox launcher to install pinned fork dependencies without mutating bun.lock and provide a foreground mode for tool-managed process lifetimes. Investigate full-suite HTTP-test resource contention if the unrelated aggregate-only failures recur in the coordinator gate.
